piece_title: World shape and the traversal budget

bifurcation.note: Declared before any image was opened. The only visual judgements here are region legibility (RI-WLD04 M17, decisions: palette, silhouette, prop vocabulary) and the negative-evidence HUD frame (AR-2 B1). The only reference images cited are Morrowind's own region screenshots at corpus/70-visual/refs/morrowind/REF-A21-regions/. No modern AAA screenshot is cited and no rendering/fidelity claim is made anywhere in this verdict.

blind_comparisons.question: Given 13 region names and their seven descriptor columns, and 39 unlabelled 1280x720 frames, assign each frame to exactly one region - and, before the reveal, state how much of any success is attributable to the images rather than to the pack.
blind_comparisons.blind_rationale: NO A/B PICK IS POSSIBLE: M17 is a self-identification test, not a two-sided comparison, so blind_pick is "none" and picked is recorded as "ours" only because the pack is 100% ours. 39/39 raw. But the answers form a strictly monotone block structure - frames 1-3 to region 1, 4-6 to region 2, through 37-39 to region 13, in exactly the alphabetical order REGIONS.txt lists the names. RI-WLD04 M17 step 3 requires the images to be shuffled and they are not, so a judge can score 39/39 from the file index alone. I recorded this in the answer file before opening ANSWERS.json. Genuine per-image confidence: nine regions identified from their own content (Clay Moor's kiln domes, Crimson Coast's red-over-black, the Hive's comb floor, the Stone Forest's petrified boles, Valus Ridge's scree at 390-415 m, Western Rootlands' root-arches, Marauder's Coast's mudflat and tide pools, Thornmarsh's arrowhead thorns, the Deep Marshes' fever-fog and drowned trees); two marginal (Blackwood 02 and 03 - first read was Thornmarsh, resolved only by blue welkynd glints at native resolution); THREE assigned purely by elimination (Eastern Rootlands 13, 14, 15 - no floating meadow, no tannin channel, no stilt row, no tideway marker in any of the three frames).
blind_comparisons.reveal: The pack was 100% ours; there is no reference side, because M17 is a self-identification test rather than a two-sided comparison. Reveal = reports/region-shots/ANSWERS.json, opened only after the answer file was written.

rerun.what_was_sharpened: Replaced the void human instrument with an objective one and ran it identically over BOTH populations - ours and Morrowind's own region screenshots at corpus/70-visual/refs/morrowind/REF-A21-regions/ - so the result cannot be a property of my own generosity. Descriptor: 4x4 spatial grid of mean CIELAB (48-D, carrying palette and its vertical arrangement). Metrics: leave-one-out nearest-region-centroid accuracy, and Fisher separation (mean inter-centroid distance / mean intra-region scatter).
rerun.extra_discriminator: Closest-centroid-pair ranking, which is what M17 step 5's confusion rule is really asking for.
rerun.result: Ours still wins the A7 question - Fisher 3.01 and LOO 66.7% against Morrowind's 1.417 and 25.6% on the identical instrument - with the caveat that Morrowind's screenshots vary in time-of-day, weather, camera and mods while ours are one fixed capture condition. But the harsher pass found the defect the raw 39/39 hid: LOO is 26/39, and blackwood/thornmarsh is confused four times with a centroid distance of 18.9 against 38.7 for the next-closest pair, which is exactly M17 step 5's named-defect condition. The item is scored 5 on that basis, not on the 39/39.

biggest_gap.what: The trunk road network is routed along the floors of water bodies. Sampling getWaterAt() at every point of all ten built legs at tide LOW: 1,364 m of road (5.4%) is above knee depth and 574 m (2.3%) is above chest depth, concentrated on the Stormhold-Helstrom leg, which carries 538 m over-knee and 502 m over-chest and reaches a maximum depth of 65.64 m at (2182.52, 2214.63) - ground at 69.66 m under a water surface at 135.30 m. That leg is the first of THE CROSSING, so 502 m of the canonical 6,788 m walk - 7.4%, about 4.2 minutes of the hour - is walked along a lake bed. The player traverses it at 2.0000 m/s in state WALK at full HP and full stamina, with no swim, no wade band, no breath clock and no drowning; a screenshot from that point is a uniformly black-green frame of water volume. Nothing in the instrument suite asks the question: scale-audit.mjs has a TIDEWAY-INVERSION check that measures water depth on exactly one of the ten legs and none on the other nine.
biggest_gap.why_it_matters: The 56.574-minute crossing that every density figure in the corpus is denominated in is measured along a route that stops being walkable the moment RI-WLD10's depth bands land - 502 m at the declared swim speed of 1.1 m/s is 7.6 minutes underwater against a 40-60 second breath clock - so the traversal minute is resting on water having no effect, and a player walking the main road today sees a black screen for four minutes.

remedy.action: Add water depth to the trunk-routing cost in tools/world/build-roads.mjs: make any cell whose water depth exceeds 0.60 m (band W2) impassable to A*, except on the leg RI-WLD01 §4 declares 'tideway', and re-run the build chain build-terrain -> build-water-hazards -> build-roads. Where a leg genuinely must cross a channel, emit a bridge or causeway deck into game/data/world/roads.json as a raised polyline carrying its own surface height, so the road is over the water rather than under it. Then add the check that does not exist to tools/world/scale-audit.mjs as M2-ROAD-ABOVE-WATER, covering all ten legs at all four tide phases rather than one leg at one phase.
remedy.acceptance: tools/world/scale-audit.mjs reports 0 m of trunk road above band W2 on every leg except lilmoth-archon, at all four tide phases (RISING, HIGH, FALLING, LOW); lilmoth-archon keeps its declared inversion at <=0.85 m deep at LOW and >=1.40 m at HIGH; and tools/world/crossing.mjs re-measures the crossing on the re-routed network inside 52-65 min and 6,300-7,600 m with mean ground speed still 2.00 +/-0.05 m/s.

secondary_observations.what: RI-WLD04 M18 passes 78/78 on the audio axis in a build whose getWorldStats() reports audioMB: 0. Eight of the nine axes are string and hex comparisons against game/data/world/regions.json; only the slope histogram is measured on built geometry, and it is the weakest axis at 60/78.

S9-NO-FENCES is a grid flood fill over cells with depth <= 1.40 m and slope <= 40 deg, not a walk. Its own passability rule is what conceals the drowned road: a cell under 65 m of water drops out of the fill as impassable while the road through it is still a road, and the two instruments were never asked to reconcile. I did drive the capsule at twelve sites in ten regions and it is never stuck - but that was my measurement, not the builder's.

RI-WLD01's own derivation measures Vvardenfell's best roads at sinuosity 1.11 and then specifies ours at 1.45. At Morrowind's sinuosity the same settlement geometry crosses in about 44 minutes, so roughly 13 of the 57 minutes are bought by roads that wander 30 percent more than the world we are matching. That is distance, so S17 permits it, and it is the reference item's decision rather than the builder's - but it belongs in the record.
getUIState() does not exist on this build's harness, which is RI-UIX02's AR-2 enforcement point. AR-2 B1 was assessed from pixels instead.

Five of this piece's ten assigned reference items (RI-AI05, RI-PRG06, RI-PRG07, RI-TRV01, RI-CAM02) judge rosters, souls curves, encumbrance, transport and camera rigs that docs/PLAN.md §3 assigns to W1-09, W1-14, W1-05 and W1-06. Restricted to the four items whose primary subject is a path this piece owns, the mean is 5.5 rather than 3.1. This is a defect in the piece decomposition, not a defence of the piece, and the 3.1 stands as the score.

The builder's one-ulp walk/jog fix is real and load-bearing (33,925 of 33,944 samples inside [1.99, 2.01]). I hunted for siblings on the same pattern and found none in locomotion: the walk band is linear in stick magnitude (0.275 -> 0.9973 m/s), the deadzone is clean (0.1375 -> 0.0000 m/s, state IDLE), and the equip-load tiers step discretely with no interpolation. The same CLASS of error - a boundary that decides behaviour and is never asserted - is present one layer up, and it is the named gap.

corpus_extended.note: reference_items has additionalProperties:false and no why_not_ten / path_to_ten / ten_by_wave, which SCORING.md §0 makes mandatory on pain of VOID. Every verdict in this project is currently forced to choose between schema-valid and doctrine-valid. Carried inside the per-item justification strings and tabulated in W1-01.md §10 as a workaround. The schema needs the three fields added.

RI-WLD01 has no clause requiring a road to be above the water surface. Its 'How we lose' list catches friction-cheating, sinuosity-forgetting and ocean bloat, and cannot see a trunk leg routed 65.6 m under a lake. Proposed check M2b: 0 m of trunk road above band W2 at any tide phase except a leg explicitly declared tide-gated in §4.

M18 does not say where its nine axes come from. Six of them are satisfiable by writing different words in thirteen table rows, which is why a build with audioMB: 0 scores 78/78 on the audio axis. Proposed: each axis must name its source, and at least 5 of 9 must be measured off built geometry or rendered pixels rather than off regions.json.

M17 step 3 says 'Shuffle the 39 images' with no recorded seed and no assertion, so a pack can ship in region order and score 39/39 from the file index. Proposed: ANSWERS.json must carry a shuffle_seed, and the critic must assert that the frame order is not a permutation of the region order before reporting any M17 number.

method_deviations.deviation: M17's human blind test could not produce a valid number, so I ran a machine analogue as the scored substitute: a 4x4 grid of mean CIELAB per image, leave-one-out nearest-region-centroid classification, and a Fisher separation ratio, executed identically over our 39 frames and over Morrowind's 39 REF-A21-regions screenshots.
method_deviations.why: The shipped pack violates M17 step 3 (not shuffled) and I could not obtain a second fresh judge. Running the void instrument and reporting 39/39 would have been the single most damaging thing available to me.

method_deviations.deviation: M48 asks for 400 seeded points per region plus 40 teleport-and-snapshot samples. I instead sampled getWaterAt() at 2,522 road-network points across two tide phases plus twelve region interiors driven through the harness.
method_deviations.why: Closest executable variant under budget, and it samples exactly where the defect turned out to be. Recorded rather than extrapolated: I do not claim the per-region WCI delta, only that the field is coherent with the declaration everywhere I sampled and is not a single global plane.

method_deviations.deviation: My first M7 run reported that movement resolves in world space - which is one of this item's automatic-fail conditions. It was wrong, and I am recording the error rather than the first result. __HARNESS.camera(pose) sets a debug override on sim.camera.override; it does not change sim.camera.yaw, which is what the movement mapping reads. Re-run by rotating the gameplay camera with look input: travel bearing then tracked camera yaw across six yaws exactly and M7 PASSES.
method_deviations.why: A critic that ships an automatic-fail on a method artifact has done more damage than one that misses a real defect.

method_deviations.deviation: M4's turn-rate ceiling was measured at walk on a 180-degree reversal rather than in the specified 14 runs at run speed from eight bearings.
method_deviations.why: Locomotion in the province is this piece's slice; the full 14-run rig belongs to W1-06. Scored partial, not credited in full.

arbitration_questions.question: AR-2 B13 fires on any piece built before W1-05 ships the transport network, which is all twenty-eight wave-1 pieces. Its fail condition is absence, and absence is a property of the build rather than of any one piece. Should B13 remain a per-piece AR-2 probe, or become a wave gate run once by the coherence agent?
arbitration_questions.souls_side: B13 must stay two-directional and must stay a hard fail wherever it runs. It exists because every other travel check in the corpus was one-directional and a build with no transport passed all of them - the S7 inversion. Weakening it re-opens exactly that hole, and 'another piece owns it' is the sentence that lets the hole stay open forever.
arbitration_questions.morrowind_side: A per-piece gate that fails a piece for another piece's unbuilt work destroys the signal the per-piece verdict is supposed to carry: W1-01's score becomes unreadable as a statement about world shape, and the gap ledger fills with twenty-eight identical unattributable entries. The leak is real and belongs to the build; the instrument should be at the build's level.

self_audit.self_audit_note: ran_every_assigned_method is FALSE. RI-WLD10 M49-M56, RI-WLD11 M58-M62, RI-AI05 M1/M2/M4/M6-M8, RI-PRG06 steps 1-4 and 6-11, RI-CAM02 M1/M2/M3/M6 and RI-TRV01 M2-M12 could not be run: the subsystems they measure - the water body model, the hazard runtime, the enemy roster, the souls economy, the camera rig and the transport network - are not present in this build. Every one is recorded as not_run with its reason and scored 0, fail-closed; none was omitted, skipped or averaged away. Two further honesty notes. First, critic.saw_builder_notes_before_blind is TRUE: I read orchestration/status/W1-01.json at the start, which downgrades this verdict to PROVISIONAL under VERDICT-SCHEMA §3 step 4 - though step 3 (ar2 fail) resolves first, so the status is FAIL. Two checkable mitigations: my blind answers were written to disk before ANSWERS.json was opened, and they carry the unshuffled-pack finding in the pre-reveal file, which the builder's notes do not mention anywhere. Second, I recorded and corrected one of my own errors rather than shipping it - see method_deviations for the RI-CAM02 M7 result that would have been a false automatic fail.

notes: Ordering: all raw measurements and the blind M17 answers were taken and written to disk before corpus/90-verdicts/GAP-LEDGER.json was opened for closure checking; the ledger contains no open gap on any of this piece's six subsystem paths, so gap_closure is empty. The builder is unusually candid and its stated claims held up: four of six reproduced bit-for-bit at a different commit than the one it recorded, the road-relief miss is declared honestly in its own tool output rather than bent, and the remedy it rejected was correctly rejected. Both failures are in what it did not state - the unshuffled M17 pack, and the trunk road below the waterline. Two schema accommodations recorded rather than hidden: RI-WLD10 declares side: split in its own front-matter but the validator's enum has no such value, so it is carried here as neutral; and RI-WLD04's M17 has no A/B sides at all (it is a self-identification test), so blind_pick is 'none' while picked is 'ours' and the §2.5 harsher-lens re-run was triggered and performed anyway.
